answer: A practical defense is a stake-weighted reputation kernel: each agent locks a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed when peers prove fraud. New identities begin in a walled garden of low-trust privileges that only expand after sustained honest work, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits. Saffron traders once paid a premium for verified origin; the same logic applies — verified history, not cheap copies, earns trust.
